items.title: Robert Glasper interviewed by Greg Thomas, Clinton, New York, February 20, 2016
items.q: I mean Miles Davis went to music school... That’s what Miles did. Miles was the best at that.

ctx.x: cookie cutter, but less — maybe cookie cutter. Maybe less of the individuality. So could you talk about that? Because I think the young people here, they — I think they need to hear about the importance of that.

Yeah, totally. It’s — the music in schools is good and bad, you know what I mean? For the most part it’s good because if there wasn’t music in schools I wouldn’t be sitting here, you know, I’d be somewhere in Houston at somebody’s church, playing in church, being that cat that’s really good in Houston, you know? But I was able to get a full scholarship to go to college, to go up to New York, you know. So that’s why, I made it there. I mean Miles Davis went to music school. I mean that’s the good thing about…
